task: Welcome to TextWorld! First stop, look and see that the portal is wide open. And then, make an attempt to go east. Then, open the door. After opening the door, go south. And then, attempt to go west. And then, try to travel south. Once you get through with that, travel east. Following that, recover the key from the floor of the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!
